entries.zh:
action: notify.mobile_app_iphone
data:
  title: 洗衣機洗完了
  message: 記得拿出來
  data:
    push:
      sound: US-EN-Alexa-Laundry-Ready.wav  # iOS 音效
      badge: 1
    actions:                                # 可點按動作
      - action: LAUNDRY_DONE
        title: 好，我來拿
      - action: LAUNDRY_SNOOZE
        title: 10 分鐘後提醒
    image: /api/camera_proxy/camera.laundry # 直接顯示相機截圖
    tag: laundry                            # 相同 tag 會覆蓋前一則
    channel: laundry                        # Android 通知通道
    ttl: 0                                  # Android 高優先
entries.en:
action: notify.mobile_app_iphone
data:
  title: The washing machine has finished washing
  message: Remember to take it out
  data:
    push:
      sound: US-EN-Alexa-Laundry-Ready.wav # iOS sound effects
      badge: 1
    actions: # Clickable actions
      - action: LAUNDRY_DONE
        title: OK, I'll get it
      - action: LAUNDRY_SNOOZE
        title: Reminder in 10 minutes
    image: /api/camera_proxy/camera.laundry # Directly display camera screenshots
    tag: laundry # The same tag will overwrite the previous one
    channel: laundry # Android notification channel
    ttl: 0 # Android high priority
